evidence.title: Code Beautify and Code Formatter For Developers - to Beautify, Validate, Minify, JSON, XML, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, Excel and more

name: CodeBeautify
summary: Free collection of 1,200+ online developer tools: formatters, beautifiers, minifiers, validators and converters.
description: Browser-based toolbox covering JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, SQL, CSV and Excel: beautifiers, minifiers, validators, viewers, editors, converters and encryption tools, plus hundreds of generators (names, text, images). Most tools run without login; registered users can save, archive and share links to their data. Input size limit is 1 MB, UTF-8.
contains: beautifiers, minifiers, validators, converters, viewers and editors
supports JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, SQL, CSV, Excel and images
free; login adds saved and archived links
